facts.en: Completed a diploma in Software Support at Fictional Institute D086 in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构院校 D086 完成软件支持专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as a supervised test assistant at Fictional App Workshop D086 from 2024-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-01 至 2026-08 在虚构应用工作室 D086 担任受监督测试助理。

facts.en: Executed approved manual test scripts in a nonproduction training environment and recorded observed results.
facts.zh: 在非生产培训环境执行获批手工测试脚本，并记录观察结果。

facts.en: Wrote issue summaries with expected and actual behavior; engineers diagnosed causes and implemented fixes.
facts.zh: 撰写包含预期及实际行为的问题摘要；工程师诊断原因并实施修复。

facts.en: With a test analyst, checked a defined set of 48 manual cases for a fictional appointment application during 2025-05.
facts.zh: 在 2025-05 与测试分析师合作，为虚构预约应用检查一组明确的 48 个手工用例。

facts.en: On the final recorded run, 45 of those 48 cases passed and 3 remained blocked by missing sample data; blocked cases were not passes.
facts.zh: 最终记录的一轮中，该组 48 个用例有 45 个通过，3 个因缺少示例数据受阻；受阻用例并非通过。

facts.en: The count describes only those executed scripts; no code-coverage percentage, exhaustive testing or defect-free product claim is supported.
facts.zh: 该计数仅描述这些执行脚本；不支持代码覆盖率、穷尽测试或产品无缺陷说法。

facts.en: Drafted 9 additional edge-case suggestions in 2025-06; the analyst accepted 4 for later planning, and none was executed in the reported run.
facts.zh: 2025-06 起草 9 个额外边界用例建议；分析师接受 4 个用于后续规划，均未在所报告轮次执行。

facts.en: Retested assigned issue fixes against analyst-approved steps without authorizing release.
facts.zh: 按分析师批准步骤复测分配的问题修复，不授权发布。

facts.en: Maintained version labels and screenshots so reviewers could identify the tested build.
facts.zh: 维护版本标签及截图，使审核者能够识别受测构建版本。

facts.en: Prepared a 2026-02 issue-template revision used by the small test team after analyst approval.
facts.zh: 2026-02 准备问题模板修订，经分析师批准后由小型测试团队使用。

facts.en: At the 2025-11 peak, supported 3 test queues; the regular 2026-08 allocation was 1.
facts.zh: 在 2025-11 高峰期支持 3 个测试队列；2026-08 常规分工为 1 个。

facts.en: Completed a 2024-09 course exercise reading simple unit-test examples; did not maintain an employer automation suite.
facts.zh: 2024-09 完成阅读简单单元测试示例的课程练习；未维护雇主自动化测试套件。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Puzzle Fair V086 on weekends from 2024-03 to 2024-08 while employed, arranging display labels.
facts.zh: 2024-03 至 2024-08 任职期间，周末在虚构谜题集市 V086 志愿布置展示标签。

facts.en: Created a personal paper maze collection in 2022 unrelated to software test design.
facts.zh: 2022 年制作个人纸面迷宫集，与软件测试设计无关。

facts.en: Enjoys sketching imaginary bridges as a hobby.
facts.zh: 以描绘想象中的桥梁为爱好。

facts.en: A draft biography says 100% coverage and zero defects, but the source records only the bounded 48-case run with 3 blocked cases.
facts.zh: 一份简介草稿称覆盖率 100% 且零缺陷，但来源仅记录范围有限的 48 用例轮次，其中 3 个受阻。

facts.en: Escalated ambiguous expected results to the test analyst rather than assigning a pass by assumption.
facts.zh: 将含糊预期结果上报测试分析师，而非凭假设判定通过。

facts.en: No production deployment, release sign-off or independently designed automated test framework is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录生产部署、发布签字或独立设计自动化测试框架经历。
